LESSON: FRUIT OF THE HOLY SPIRIT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.5: Fruit of the Holy Spirit

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Fruit of the Holy Spirit. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you have the fruit of the Holy Spirit?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. list the fruit of the Holy Spirit; Galatians 5:22- 23,
2. describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives,
3. desire to be led by the Holy Spirit in their daily activities. The learner is guided to: flash cards and display it in class, do to others as Christians, Holy Spirit in their daily lives, of the Holy Spirit. Why should you have the fruit of the Holy Spirit?

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. list the fruit of the Holy Spirit; Galatians 5:22- 23,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to list the fruit of the Holy Spirit; Galatians 5:22- 23,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. desire to be led by the Holy Spirit in their daily activities. The learner is guided to: flash cards and display it in class, do to others as Christians, Holy Spirit in their daily lives, of the Holy Spirit. Why should you have the fruit of the Holy Spirit?
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to desire to be led by the Holy Spirit in their daily activities. The learner is guided to: flash cards and display it in class, do to others as Christians, Holy Spirit in their daily lives, of the Holy Spirit. Why should you have the fruit of the Holy Spirit?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Fruit of the Holy Spirit.
2. Explain Fruit of the Holy Spirit to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: in pairs, read Galatians 5:22-23,
4. Show that you can: list the fruit of the Holy Spirit; Galatians 5:22- 23,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Fruit of the Holy Spirit. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why should you have the fruit of the Holy Spirit?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In pairs, read Galatians 5:22-23,
2. List the fruit of the Holy Spirit
3. In groups, list good things they should do to others as Christians,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. list the fruit of the Holy Spirit; Galatians 5:22- 23,
2. describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives,
3. desire to be led by the Holy Spirit in their daily activities. The learner is guided to: flash cards and display it in class, do to others as Christians, Holy Spirit in their daily lives, of the Holy Spirit. Why should you have the fruit of the Holy Spirit?

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
